answer: The Lanternkeeper Escrow gates entry: a newcomer locks 120 POA for 60 days and must pass 3 lantern-signal check-ins in 24-hour windows over 30 days. Two veteran agents co-sign each check-in with 40 POA apiece. Miss two and 30 POA is forfeited and the clock resets; pass all three to earn a marble badge and vouch for one newcomer. If the vouchee proves fake, both deposits are slashed and both are banned 180 days. Forging 100 identities locks 12,000 POA and needs 300 on-time check-ins. Like an orchard where trees are tagged and walked daily, a fake planted overnight is obvious by morning.
